claim: TradFi benchmark fail-closed veto: offline/unreachable MCP feed throws BenchmarkFeedUnavailableError by default, adapter seals HARD_VETO with zero execution, TESTNET/DEMO/LIVE dispatcher boots only with credentials, Demo integration gated behind BITGET_* + LIVE_DEMO_RUN=1; and a real Bitget Demo order was placed, accepted, filled and read back (venue orderId, fill, fee, open position)
limitations: LIVE_DEMONSTRATED on Bitget DEMO TRADING ONLY (paptrading:1). NOT the live venue. No real capital.
Full Demo position lifecycle proven: open (orderId 1489095619363635201, filled @ 83364.4) -> close (orderId 1489108454353305601, filled @ 83061.9, realized +0.3025 USDT) -> position read back FLAT.
Total round-trip fees 0.09985578 USDT on Demo. Demo balance only.
NOT proven: settlement mechanics beyond one round trip (no funding accrual across an interval, no liquidation, no withdrawal), live-venue execution, or continuous operation.
The close was executed by a one-off script, NOT by OrderDispatcher. The dispatcher has no close/cancel method and hardcodes tradeSide:'open'. See GAP-011.
Root cause of the first close failure: in hedge_mode `side` is the POSITION DIRECTION, so closing a short needs side=sell + tradeSide=close; side=buy yields venue 22002 'No position to close'.

Root cause of the first open failure (40774) was an account position-mode mismatch. Fixed by explicit positionMode in OrderDispatcher (commit c37a163d7b48341d36fa3325f0d4650ef8f851ce), guard packages/engine/test/dispatcher-position-mode.test.ts.

CORRECTION: earlier evidence claimed Demo exposes no mix order query routes. Wrong paths. /detail, /orders-pending, /orders-history, /fills all return 00000 on Demo. Only /fill-history is Demo-unsupported.
Local Risk Boy used a synthetic equity shape; the venue performed the real margin check.
statement: TradFi benchmark fail-closed veto: offline/unreachable MCP feed throws BenchmarkFeedUnavailableError by default, adapter seals HARD_VETO with zero execution, TESTNET/DEMO/LIVE dispatcher boots only with credentials, Demo integration gated behind BITGET_* + LIVE_DEMO_RUN=1; and a real Bitget Demo order was placed, accepted, filled and read back (venue orderId, fill, fee, open position)
